name: Bracelet of Gentle Mending
summary: A bracelet that closes small wounds as a creature rests.
description: Hospitallers wear these on the left wrist, where the pulse is. The bracelet warms when an ally nearby is hurt.

stats.effect: The bracelet has 3 charges. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 charge to touch a creature and restore 2d4 + 2 hit points to it. The bracelet regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
